definitions.initialAcceptance: an offspring is admitted when it is among the N survivors of the birth selection (train MSE, ties to the older individual)
definitions.individualSurvival: the individual itself is in the population exactly h generations after its birth
definitions.descendantContribution: at least one member of the population h generations after its birth is the individual or descends from it
definitions.censoring: an individual born after G - h has no h-generation reading; it is excluded from that horizon's rates and counted as censored
definitions.turnover: admitted offspring in a generation / N
definitions.lineageDepth: 0 for a seed, parent depth + 1 for an offspring
definitions.team: both groupings are reported: the Genus species key (Species.calculateKey) of the offspring at birth, and its founder clade (the generation-0 seed it descends from)

manifest.holdoutPolicy: reporting only, read once at the final generation; never read by selection, mutation or parent weighting
manifest.costPolicy: recordsScored charges train + calibration records for every evaluation, seeds included; holdout records are reported separately and never charged; the behavioural-diversity probe activations are counted as diagnosticRecords and also never charged
manifest.calibrationPolicy: the biased arm weights parents by rank of calibration MSE only, with best-to-worst odds capped at oddsCap
manifest.causalityCaveat: lineage/admission associations are predictive correlations, not causal value
